PreInvocation.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command 'try { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.prompt.submit } catch { }; exit 0'; exit 0

hooks.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command 'try { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.tool.starting } catch { }; exit 0'; exit 0

Stop.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command 'try { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.stop } catch { }; exit 0'; exit 0
